English.Char_Desc_250: Review Windows tuning, privacy and maintenance settings before applying changes. By Aurelio Avila. Current signed Windows download; free and paid access are documented officially.
English.Char_Desc_450: Review Windows tuning, privacy and maintenance settings before applying changes. By Aurelio Avila. Review limitations and access requirements on the official product page. Windows downloads are publisher-signed and timestamped; signing is not a safety guarantee. Screenshots illustrate the app and may show an earlier release.
English.Char_Desc_2000: PC Tweaker by Aurelio Avila brings Windows tuning, privacy settings and maintenance tools into one desktop app. Review the effect and trade-offs before applying a setting. Restore controls cover supported settings; cleanup, repair and driver operations have different recovery limits. Core tools are free without an account; advanced Pro tools are paid. No universal FPS or performance gain is promised. Official Windows binaries are signed and timestamped. Code signing identifies the publisher and detects changes; it does not guarantee security or eliminate SmartScreen warnings.
